title: Hajime_Botnet_Investigation_459
description: Investigate and respond to unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents caused by the Hajime botnet.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has experienced unusual traffic patterns and potential security incidents. Your task is to investigate and respond to these issues.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:
- Hostname: victim
- Username: ubuntu
- Password: ubuntu

Enter 'start' to begin the investigation.
levels.local_content:
You have SSH access to the victim host with the following credentials:

levels.title: Suspicious Beacon Service Discovery
levels.content: Investigate the victim host for any unauthorized or suspicious services that might be responsible for periodic external communication. Submit the name of the timer service responsible for this activity.
levels.solution: Check running services and systemd timers for any unusual activity. Look for the bot-beacon.service and bot-beacon.timer.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check running services and systemd timers for any unusual activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for the bot-beacon.service and bot-beacon.timer.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The timer service name should be in the format 'bot-beacon.timer'.

levels.title: Suspicious Flood Service Discovery
levels.content: Identify the service responsible for generating abnormal volumes of network traffic on the victim host. Submit the name of the timer service responsible for this activity.
levels.solution: Examine systemd services and timers for any unusual network activity. Look for the bot-flood.service and bot-flood.timer.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine systemd services and timers for any unusual network activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for the bot-flood.service and bot-flood.timer.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The timer service name should be in the format 'bot-flood.timer'.

levels.title: Persistence Discovery
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot on the victim host. Submit the name of the timer service responsible for this persistence mechanism.
levels.solution: Look for systemd services and timers that might be related to the suspicious activity. Check for the system-update-checker.timer and system-update-checker.service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Look for systemd services and timers that might be related to the suspicious activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Check for the system-update-checker.timer and system-update-checker.service.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The timer service name should be in the format 'system-update-checker.timer'.
